source_of_truth: The fleet dashboard renders only registered projects but presents them as 'where DontPanic is used.' Observed usage lives in ~/.dontpanic/invocations.jsonl keyed by a per-path hash (path_key) that does not canonicalize across worktrees, and temp worktrees are deleted before the dashboard runs. This plan stamps durable canonical-repo identity at write time, backfills history once from operator-local evidence, and exposes a metadata-only registry-vs-observed reconciliation, without ever recommending temp paths.
completion_test: Done when an isolated fixture registry with DontPanic absent plus dogfooding ledger records from p2a/p2-lock/main produces exactly one canonical used_unregistered 'dontpanic' candidate keyed on canonical_repo_key with a safe suggested_name, while a D010-like fixture registry with DontPanic registered classifies the same canonical repo as registered_active. `dontpanic projects discover --json` emits scrubbed display + keys + counts/recency + suggestion status + suggested_name only, with no temp path ever recommended, no raw home path, and no reconstructed raw add-command path in JSON; default human output may print the locally reconstructed add command. registered_path_missing and registered_unresolved rows use registry_name + registry_path_key with canonical_repo_key=null, and registered_active vs registered_stale follows the C5 truth table for inactive entries, missing paths, unresolved canonicalization, absent observations, invalid timestamps, low count, stale recency, and passing thresholds. This is backed by a ledger writer that stamps a nullable canonical_repo at log time (durable_checkout describing the canonical, temp paths never self-canonicalized), compaction that preserves observed_count and fails closed on mixed canonical attribution via canonical_compaction_conflict, explicit ledger-to-observed_canonical and registry-to-registered_canonical adapters, pinned C5 defaults (window_days=14, min_count=2, timestamp=last_seen, inclusive boundaries), and a one-time idempotent backfill of historical records that validates the exact evidence schema including required field presence, exact types, and no-secret-shape origin_key checks before copy, copies origin_key only from the single confirmed canonical entry, normalizes any written path_display through the shared scrubber, refuses temp canonical evidence, and coordinates with the live writer lock so concurrent appends are not lost, while repo.path_key stays unchanged for bucket/conflict logic. The seven binding contracts C1-C7 are defined in plan.md and decisions D003-D008.

user_journeys.name: operator-runs-discover-and-sees-canonical-truth
user_journeys.description: In an isolated test registry where DontPanic is absent, an operator who has dogfooded DontPanic from temp worktrees runs `dontpanic projects discover --json` and sees exactly one canonical 'dontpanic' used_unregistered candidate (collapsing p2a/p2-lock/main), not three temp-path phantoms, with an observed count and a recency that passes the threshold. In a complementary D010-like registry where DontPanic is registered, the same observed canonical repo is registered_active instead.
acceptance_signals: discover --json keys candidates on canonical_repo_key
The ledger-to-observed_canonical adapter skips records without canonical_repo, aggregates count + max last_seen by canonical_repo_key, preserves scrubbed display, and never reads command
Compacted ledger rows preserve observed_count, and legacy rows without observed_count count as 1
Mixed-attribution compacted rows are marked canonical_compaction_conflict=true and ignored by observed_canonical_from_ledger so counts are not inflated or dropped silently
The registry-to-registered_canonical adapter computes registered canonical keys and path_exists before pure reconcile; reconcile itself performs no filesystem/git IO
registered_path_missing and registered_unresolved rows are keyed by registry_name + registry_path_key with canonical_repo_key=null
With an isolated registry where DontPanic is absent, the three observed DontPanic paths collapse to one used_unregistered candidate
With a D010-like registry where DontPanic is registered, the same canonical repo is registered_active

registered_active vs registered_stale follows the C5 truth table for inactive entries, missing paths, unresolved canonicalization, absent observations, invalid timestamps, low count, stale recency, and passing thresholds
Default policy is deterministic: window_days=14, min_count=2, timestamp=last_seen, inclusive observed_count and recency boundaries
used_unregistered rows carry a project-name-regex-safe suggested_name derived from scrubbed display and canonical key
Temp-prefixed paths never appear as recommended projects
--json output contains scrubbed display + keys + counts/recency + suggestion status + suggested_name only; no raw home path and no reconstructed raw add-command path
A record with a secret-shaped command still yields clean output
discover does not install, modify, remove, chain, read, or depend on git hooks

user_journeys.name: writer-stamps-canonical-identity-without-breaking-buckets
user_journeys.description: A new invocation in a linked worktree records a canonical_repo resolving to the main checkout while repo.path_key stays the worktree path; existing conflict/bucket behavior is unchanged.
acceptance_signals: canonical_repo {path_key, path_display, durable_checkout, origin_key?} present on the record, resolving to the durable main checkout
repo.path_key equals the observed worktree path key
_bucket_key / conflict regression test passes unchanged
A temp worktree resolving to durable DontPanic stamps canonical_repo.durable_checkout=true (C3 case 3a); an unresolved temp path stamps NO canonical_repo (C3 case 3b)
No raw home path or origin URL persisted

user_journeys.name: backfill-is-idempotent-and-refuses-ambiguity
user_journeys.description: The operator runs the one-time backfill against the captured evidence; matching historical records gain canonical_repo, a second run is a no-op, and any ambiguous/unconfirmable mapping is reported and left untouched.
acceptance_signals: --dry-run reports would_stamp / would_skip / already_stamped as counts, with skipped as the detail list of {path_key, reason}
Re-running produces no further mutation

The evidence file schema is exact: schema_version 1.0, canonical_repos map, observation_path_key_to_canonical map to lists of canonical keys, required canonical fields, exact value types, and no-secret-shape validation
Ambiguous or absent observation keys are skipped and reported

The C4 evidence matrix skips malformed fields, missing required fields, wrong value types, raw-secret-shaped values, path_key mismatch, non-reconstructable scrub token, failed path-key confirmation, reconstructed temp canonical path, and durable_checkout=true claimed for a temp canonical path; origin_key is copied only from the single confirmed canonical evidence entry after hash-shape/no-secret validation
Literal home-path evidence is normalized to <home>-scrubbed path_display before any canonical_repo write
Write-mode backfill holds the live writer ledger lock across read/validate/write/temp-file/rename so concurrent invocation appends are serialized or the backfill refuses without replacement
Backfill entrypoint, default DONTPANIC_HOME-resolved paths, exit codes, and JSON report schema are pinned
Ledger record order and unrelated fields preserved
Evidence file is not committed, enforced by a repo-local .gitignore entry for .dontpanic/canonical-backfill-evidence.json plus a commit-guard test/doc check
backfill-canonical does not install, modify, remove, chain, read, or depend on git hooks

non_goals: What-Now advisory, selector count badge, cwd nudge, honesty disclosure line (deferred, demand-gated)
